completionCriteria: Every decision is adjudicated by the named accountable human reviewer roles.
Approved local policies are versioned, scoped to organization/site, and independently tested.
Clinical approval and local-policy approval are recorded separately.
A new explicit production-activation review confirms patient-facing language, monitoring, escalation, audit retention, and rollback controls.
No passing engineering test is treated as approval.
